reason: All six linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail with a dependency solver error: "No candidates were found for cross-python_linux-riscv64 *." This is an infrastructure-level missing package, not a code or recipe bug. All non-riscv64 platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, win_64, win_arm64, osx_64, osx_arm64) pass. No action can be taken on the feedstock side until cross-python_linux-riscv64 becomes available in the conda-forge channel.
